lydia_activated: 🟢 NEURAL LINK ESTABLISHED — {botName} is now active in #{channel}
lydia_deactivated: 🔴 NEURAL LINK TERMINATED — {botName} has been deactivated in #{channel}
memory_empty_hint:
**How to save:** While chatting, include:
`[MEMORY: key | value]`
fallback_1: N da len ba tɛ o la kɔsɛbɛ. N bɛ se ka i dɛmɛ ni fɛn min bɛ nka yamaruya kan — i bɛ sen ka ɲinikali kɛ ni economy, leveling, wala moderation kan, walima i ka `{prefix}help` ci walasa ka yamaruya kɔmandiw (commandes) ye.
fallback_2: N ma kunnafoni jɔn sɔrɔ nin ko in kan. I b'a fɛ n ka ɲini interneti kan wa, walima n bɛ se ka i dɛmɛ ni fɛn wɛrɛ ye min bɛ bot ka kɔmandi (commandes) yamaruyalenw kɔnɔ?
fallback_3: Nin tɛ n ka dɔnniya kɔnɔ. N bɛ n sinsin ARCHON CG-223 ka sistɛmuw dɛmɛ kan dɔrɔn. I b'a fɛ ka mun dɔn?
key_saved_tip: Hakilina: i ka kile (clé) bɛ mara serveur ka dogoyɔrɔ ɲumanw kan, a tɛ jira baro kɔnɔ abada.
